genius.notes: Review dated 2026-10-07. Current USDC terms and September 28 Circle Mint agreement continue to name Circle Internet Financial, LLC for U.S. issuance; the EEA issuer remains Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS. The OCC's December 12 charter decision expressly says First National Digital Currency Bank will not issue stablecoins and describes a planned, distinct New York trust-company issuer. The active OCC trust-bank list and July 10 final charter announcement establish the affiliate's charter, not GENIUS PPSI approval for the LLC. The September 8 licensing page likewise distinguishes affiliate bank/trust charters from LLC licenses. issuerPathway is unknown because these sources do not establish the LLC's exact GENIUS route; primaryFederalRegulator is omitted rather than attributing the affiliate's OCC oversight to this issuer. Circle publicly states GENIUS readiness, supporting intent only. Direct par redemption is subject to eligible-account terms and fees. Current transparency links monthly examinations; the August report confirms the LLC/SAS issuers. No token-specific GENIUS enforcement action was located in the finite search. The Act remains pre-effective; the September 30 SCRC procedural interim rule does not approve Circle or alter this issuer assessment.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: In these sources checked on 2026-10-07, no USDC/Circle Internet Financial, LLC GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification or regulator-confirmed application was located. The bank affiliate is independently active, but the regulator decision limits it to reserve/trust/custody services and excludes stablecoin issuance. No token-specific GENIUS enforcement action was located in the finite search. This does not establish the absence of confidential filings or approvals outside the reviewed sources.
